provenance.originalBody:
**suggestion (non-blocking):** `errorToDebugMessage(err)` is passed a guaranteed-nil `err` in the phantom-user branch.

<details><summary><sub>context</sub></summary>

`errorToDebugMessage(err)` on line 180 is always passed a nil `err`. Control flow reaches line 175 only when `ktx.RequestUser()` on line 166 returned a nil error (the non-nil case returns at line 169), and `errorToDebugMessage` (line 157) short-circuits with `if err == nil { return nil }`. So every phantom/not-logged-in rejection returns `UNAUTHORIZED` with `debugMessage: null`, discarding the reason — while the `errors.Unauthorized()` constructed on line 176 for the log line is thrown away instead of being reused for the client-facing debug message. Introduced by this change; the four new tests all authenticate, so none covers this branch.

A sketch, not a committable replacement:

````
	if !acl.IsLoggedIn(ktx, acl.PhantomProhibited) {
		unauthorizedErr := errors.Unauthorized()
		ktx.Log().Warn(unauthorizedErr)
		return _mapErrorToAllClassrooms(
			graphql.WritingCoachConfigErrorCodeUnauthorized,
			&response,
			errorToDebugMessage(unauthorizedErr),
		), nil
	}
````

<sub>found by correctness-reviewer</sub>

</details>

replies.body: This isn't a suggestion. `errorToDebugMessage` handles `nil` errors.

claims.reason: Supported core concern, corrected only the inaccurate details or visible summary.

corrected.subject: Phantom-user rejections return UNAUTHORIZED without the debug reason, so reuse the unauthorized error for the message.
